text:
oliver: Heads-up from a new-hire pairing session: sampleapp demo caused duplicated orders when token TTL was short and 429s popped up. Minimal repro in staging.

nina: not great. was the SDK blindly replaying POST bodies after refresh? that's the usual culprit.

oliver: yup. sequence: request -> short-lived token expired mid-request -> client refreshes -> retries original request -> some retries returned 429 -> client backs off and retries again -> server created two orders.

pat: we've kept automatic idempotency out to avoid unexpectedly changing semantics, but DX for onboarding is rough. sampleapp should show best-practice pattern.

nina: idea: add an opt-in SDK flag 'safeReplay' that does two things: (1) attach X-Redwood-Req-Id for server-side dedupe, (2) keep a tiny in-process cache of recent req ids for safeReplayWindowMs. Default off for parity.

oliver: short mitigation: switch 429 backoff to full jitter and add a small no-retry-after-refresh guard (e.g., 400ms) to avoid immediate replay storms after a token rotation.

pat: also saw stampeding from parallel onboarding runs. we should add a per-process retry cap (token-bucket) to throttle concurrent retries and jitter each request's backoff seed.

nina: sample snippet to show docs and sampleapp (node):
```js
// demo: explicit idempotency header
fetch('/v1/orders', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer <token>', 'Idempotency-Key': uuidv4() },
  body: JSON.stringify({ item: 'sticker' })
})
```
This plus server-side dedupe example would make onboarding safer.

oliver: edge case: client/server clock skew made client-window dedupe brittle. recommend server anchor dedupe TTL to arrival time and treat client headers as advisory.

pat: telemetry ask: when safeReplay is enabled emit events dedupe.hit / dedupe.miss + last-refresh-age so Console can show how often replays were prevented and whether token rotation is the driver.

nina: defaults proposal for SDK jitter/backoff: baseDelay=120ms, maxDelay=1800ms, jitter=full. safeReplayWindowMs default 2000ms, noRetryAfterRefreshMs default 500ms. document tradeoffs heavily.

infra-bot: staging note: 2026-03-20T11:07:12Z - onboarding-run produced 12 duplicate orders; QA cleaned.

oliver: implementation plan: 1) update node + python SDKs with opt-in safeReplay + X-Redwood-Req-Id header behind flag 2) change backoff defaults to full jitter and add no-retry-after-refresh guard 3) sampleapp: add explicit idempotency example and opt-in safeReplay config in demo 4) docs: idempotency cookbook + token rotation pitfalls 5) telemetry keys for Console.

pat: i'll take the SDK PR for node. nina can you update sampleapp?

nina: yes, i'll add the demo changes and a short doc blurb in onboarding.

oliver: can we also add a tiny CI scenario that simulates token rotation + transient 429s so we don't regress?

pat: good call. add test harness ticket too.

nina: follow-ups created: SAMP-318, DOC-659, SDK-1102, TELE-101
